results.llm_raw: {"say":"The goal needs a two-quadrant half shape, so a cutter must sit on the stream feeding the hub; I put a cutter on the first hub feed and a trash on the next so the waste half is consumed.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B135","asCell":true},"machine":{"kind":"cutter"},"opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"cut the full shape right where it enters the hub so the matching half is what gets delivered"},{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B136","asCell":true},"machine":{"kind":"trash"},"opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"absorb the other half next to the cutter so the cut does not jam"}]}

{"say":"Nothing is delivered even though the hub already has belt B135/B136/B137 feeding it, so the incoming stream is the wrong shape; I convert that run into cutter+trash right at the hub so the RuRu---- half is what enters and the other half is discarded.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B135","B136","B137"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left"}]},"why":"Cut the shapes on the only belts that are guaranteed to reach the hub, keeping the goal half and trashing the other."}]}

{"say":"Goal is a half shape (RuRu----); the visible miner feed runs only carry full shapes into the balancers, so cut them in place with a cutter and trash the byproduct half, per the documented replace_run pattern.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B63","B69","B81","B90","B97","B105","B112"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left"}]},"why":"Miners feed full shapes straight into L3; cut the run so L3 receives the required half and the byproduct is trashed."},{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$bbox_of":["B64","B70","B82","B91","B98"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"left"}]},"why":"Second feed into L3 needs the same cut so both balancer inputs carry matching half shapes."}]}
